entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's a piece of junk.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the VeloBand. To make sure I get you to the right place, can you tell me a bit more? Is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?
It's a technical fault! The heart rate monitor is completely inaccurate. One minute it says my heart rate is 50, the next it's 180 while I'm just sitting here. The thing is absolute garbage.
I see. I can certainly look into that for you. Sometimes a firmware update or a factory reset can resolve syncing issues like that. Would you be open to trying a few troubleshooting steps with me?
No! I don't have time for that nonsense. I'm not your IT guy. I bought a product that was supposed to work, and it doesn't. I just want my money back.
I understand your frustration. Let me just pull up your order details. Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered to you on January 4th, which was 14 days ago.
So? Get on with it. I want a refund.

I understand. Per our policy, the VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return window for a full refund. Since we're on day 14 and you're reporting a defect, the standard procedure is to connect you with our Technical Support team. They can verify the fault and authorize a warranty replacement for you.
Are you kidding me? 10 days? That's insane! I don't want a replacement of your garbage product, I want my money. This is completely unacceptable. Get me your manager, now!

My supervisor would have to tell you the same policy, sir. Without verifying the defect through our technical team, a return for a refund is not possible outside the 10-day window. It's a hygiene and account security policy specific to the Pulse.

This is a scam! I'm going to post a review on every single website telling people how VeloFit cheats its customers. I'm telling you, I will make sure everyone knows about this. Just process the refund.

I'm sorry you feel that way, but my options are limited. A refund is not something I can authorize under these circumstances. My best path forward to help you is to transfer you to Technical Support. They are equipped to solve the problem with the device.
Forget it. You've been completely useless. I'll just dispute the charge with my credit card company. You'll be hearing from them.
